name: Sunfire Spark
description: Flick a spark where sun heat and open flame run together to land as a small bright burn.

name: Fireglow Guard
description: Hold a guard of mingled flame and glow that scorches whatever touches it.

name: Heatseer
description: Read the mingled heat of the surroundings to find living bodies and live flames.

name: Sunflame Palm
description: Strike with a palm of fused fire and light that sears the guard of an opponent.

name: Fireglow Bloom
description: Open a bloom of flame and glare that scorches the ground and dazzles the eyes.

name: Sunfire Brand
description: Burn a mark of joined fire and light on the target that holds it to the user.

name: Sunfire Lance
description: Drive a lance of fused sun and flame through a shield wall of stone or steel.

name: Solar Furnace
description: Raise the heat of sun and flame together until the ground turns to a furnace for the foe.

name: Sunfire Corona
description: Wreathe the user in a corona of joined sun and fire that burns outward in rings.

name: Sunfire Convergence
description: streams: Sun + Fire. Fuse the sun and flame into one stream no single force could make and pour it over the foe to melt plate and scour the field.

name: Lifelight Touch
description: Touch a hurt with a hand that carries both sun warmth and the living force and close the skin.

name: Bloom Warmth
description: Let a warmth like early spring spread over an ally or the self and ease their aches.

name: Vital Sunbeam
description: Send a beam of vital warmth into an ally and renew their breath and strength.

name: Greensun Sense
description: Read where life is strong or failing in every body in reach.

name: Lifelight Purge
description: Burn rot and poison from an ally while the living force rebuilds the flesh behind the fire.

name: Quickening Sun
description: Quicken the healing and the stride of an ally with a bright pulse of vitality.

name: Growth Glow
description: Coax torn flesh to regrow under a patient golden glow.

name: Sunbloom Ward
description: Spread a ward of living gold that closes small cuts in those it covers.

name: Verdant Dawn
description: Raise a green-gold dawn that heals the wounded across the near ranks at once.

name: Lifelight Revival
description: Pour sun and life together into a freshly fallen ally and bring the breath back before the window shuts.

name: Evergreen Sun
description: Hold an unfading sun over the wounded and mend them while it fills them with fresh strength.

name: Radiant Vitality
description: streams: Sun + Life. Fuse the sun's warmth and the living force into a single rising tide that heals the wounded and wakes growth in the ground beneath them.

name: Prism Glint
description: Throw a glint split into many colours that stings the eyes of those who meet it.

name: Brightlens Sense
description: Read the way light bends round hidden things to find what is covered.

name: Gleaming Guard
description: Hold a polished guard that throws a blow off in glints.

name: Lightsun Touch
description: Rest a hand shining with sun and pure light on a wound and let the shining close it.

name: Prism Split
description: Split one beam into a spread that falls on a whole group.

name: Lightsun Mend
description: Mend a deep wound with a steady shining that leaves the flesh clean.

name: Brilliance Purge
description: Burn every false taint and shadow from an ally with a plain brilliant light.

name: Gleam Bind
description: Wind a net of gleams round an opponent and hold the limbs in place.

name: Prismatic Sunbeam
description: Drive a many-coloured beam through the layers of a guard in one burning pass.

name: Brilliance Revival
description: Flood the chest of a freshly fallen ally with shining brilliance and call the pulse back.

name: Lightsun Canopy
description: Spread a bright canopy over the ranks that turns back heavy volleys.

name: Searing Brilliance
description: Pour a brilliance so fierce over the foe that cloth and flesh burn together.

name: Hallowed Daybright
description: streams: Sun + Light. Join the sun's fire and pure light into one clear stream that burns what is false and shows what is true.

name: Glory Prism
description: streams: Sun + Light. Raise a vast prism that gathers the sun and splits it into a thousand rays that each strike a separate foe.
